properties.description: Requesting Shoreline Permit Exemption for work in the right-of-way  to be completed by Seattle City Light in partnership with SDOT. City Light will install and operate a small Level 2 Electric Vehicle Charging Station in the right-of-way in front of 1938 Fairview Ave E that will serve existing street parking. The project involves the installation of a precast foundation pedestal  a Type 2 handhole  approximately 20 feet of underground electrical conduit  and a conduit riser on SCL pole # 131256
